- Documentation content updated in SKILL.md; expanded workflow, usage examples, and improved formatting.
- No changes to logic, features, or code in this release.
- Information is now clearer for new users, including step-by-step guidance and detailed parameter explanations.
- Existing commands and workflow remain unchanged.

vincent-trade-manager v1.0.0

- Initial release of Trade Manager for automated stop-loss, take-profit, and trailing stop rules on Polymarket positions.
- Integrated into the Vincent backend—no separate service required.
- Supports real-time monitoring via WebSocket, with polling as a fallback.
- CLI tools for creating, updating, listing, and canceling trading rules.
- Event log and audit trail for all rule actions and status changes.
- Trades respect all Vincent spending limits and approval policies.
